corrections.why: The Register describes volunteers refurbishing and reopening the lookout in September 1999; it does not describe staffing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register, the FFLOS page and the ANFFLA page name the Curve Fire; the Forest Lookouts page names the Leona Fire. The story reports both and follows the three sources that name the Curve Fire. No fire record was checked.

notes_for_editor: Fire name disagreement is not resolved against a fire record; the web search budget ran out before one could be checked. The brief's 1999 event was labeled staffed; the Register wording is refurbished and reopened, so it is relabeled restored. The 1960 Sandy DeLapp clipping is not counted because it does not name this tower. No source in this pass describes the site today or public access. Photo credits on the Register page not added.
